games.pitch: One hammer, one pot, one enormous pile of junk. Climb it, and try not to lose everything on a single swing.
Eat, grow and outmanoeuvre every other worm on the map. Classic snake, with a crowd.
Push the words around to rewrite each level's rules. One of the cleverest puzzle games anywhere.
The card game everyone knows, with wilds, draw-twos and nobody stuck shuffling.
Dash along the tracks, hop the barriers and see how far a single run can take you.
Drop, match and merge fruit, then plan around the stones and bombs that get in the way.
Guard your base and clear the field in a remake of the arcade tank classic.
Klondike solitaire, clean and quick. A good one for a five-minute break.
